phase: CarePoint Phase 4 - Controlled Pilot / Go-Live Execution

deliveryPlan.title: Pilot execution charter, scope, gates, and cohort plan
deliveryPlan.objective: Establish governed pilot/go-live execution boundaries before launch.

deliveryPlan.title: Staging deployment rehearsal and environment activation
deliveryPlan.objective: Prove deployment, environment, secrets, migration, backup, and smoke execution path.

deliveryPlan.title: Controlled pilot launch runbook and day-0/day-1 execution
deliveryPlan.objective: Execute the first controlled pilot launch window with evidence capture.

deliveryPlan.title: Pilot monitoring, support, incident triage, and daily health review
deliveryPlan.objective: Monitor live pilot usage and manage issues under support governance.

deliveryPlan.title: Pilot feedback, defect burn-down, adoption evidence, and expansion decision
deliveryPlan.objective: Assess user feedback, defect posture, adoption signals, and readiness to expand.

deliveryPlan.title: Final go-live execution certificate and phase closure
deliveryPlan.objective: Close the controlled pilot/go-live execution phase with final decision evidence.
exitCriteria: Phase closed or corrective release opened

pilotRoles.responsibility: Own scope, cohort, pilot calendar, and daily pilot decision.
Own go/no-go, rollback, release promotion, and launch approval.
Confirm pilot workflow acceptance and real-user readiness.
Own issue intake, escalation, and daily support review.
Own environment health, logs, integrations, and emergency triage.
Confirm QA-V7 evidence remains valid during pilot execution.

releaseGates.name: QA closure accepted
releaseGates.requiredEvidence: QA-V7 closure package and audit reports

releaseGates.name: Environment ready
releaseGates.requiredEvidence: Build, env, secrets, migration, backup, observability checklist

releaseGates.name: Support ready
releaseGates.requiredEvidence: Support channel, escalation path, severity rules

releaseGates.name: Rollback ready
releaseGates.requiredEvidence: Rollback owner, triggers, path, and decision authority

rollbackTriggers: Data corruption or suspected data loss
Clinical workflow blocker affecting Provider users
API/worker failure that blocks core pilot workflows
Repeated severe support incidents during the pilot window
Inability to capture required audit or operational evidence

controlledScopeTemplate.users: Limit to named pilot users or a small role-based cohort.
controlledScopeTemplate.operatingWindow: Use a defined pilot launch window with support coverage.
controlledScopeTemplate.dataPolicy: Use approved pilot data and document rollback impact.

nextRecommendedDelivery: PILOT-V2 - Staging deployment rehearsal and environment activation
